realtimeInspector.joinAChannelToWatchBroadcast: Join a channel to watch Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes as they happen, and send test broadcasts. The socket uses the service role, so policies don't limit what you see.
realtimeInspector.theSocketCanSendAsWell: The socket can send as well as listen, with the service role.
realtimeInspector.watchingRealtimeNeedsARoleThat: Watching Realtime needs a role that can change data
realtimeInspector.joinAChannelToSeeMessages: Join a channel to see messages here
realtimeInspector.schemaNotPublished: No tables in {{schema}} are in the supabase_realtime publication, so no changes will arrive. Add them under <link>Database › Publications</link>.
realtimeInspector.tableNotPublished: {{schema}}.{{table}} isn't in the supabase_realtime publication, so no changes will arrive. Add it under <link>Database › Publications</link>.

realtimePolicies.policiesOnRealtimeMessagesDecideWho: Policies on realtime.messages decide who can receive and send Broadcast and Presence messages on private channels. Public channels and Postgres Changes don't use them.

realtime.theSocketFailedCheckThatThe: The socket failed. Check that the stack runs Realtime.
